senses.example: Mi cuñado está en el paro desde marzo.
senses.exampleGloss: My brother-in-law has been unemployed since March.

alternatives.reason: Official and formal; the word in statistics and news.
paro also means a work stoppage; huelga is the everyday word for a strike.

notes: estar en el paro is the fixed Peninsular phrase. Also paro = stoppage (paro cardíaco, paro laboral).
